rationale:

The user explicitly confirmed both exchanges. 

Cons (material policy failures):

- The post-write confirmation (“Your exchange request has been processed”) and return-instructions email are asserted without tool confirmation details (no exchange confirmation ID, no returned status), making the final information partially unsupported.
- The new variant/item IDs used in the write are not visible in the product detail outputs shown (due to truncation, but still not evidenced), further weakening support for the claimed specifics.

Given the requirement to avoid fabricated or unsupported statements and to provide correct final information, this conversation does not meet the pass bar despite otherwise solid steps (authentication and confirmation).
